## Context / Problem
Ten contract-interface files contain 32 audited prose blocks. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`; stable anchors replace broad line ranges.

## Approach
Condense only the anchored comments and true leading docstrings in Scope. Preserve every non-docstring runtime string, constant, regex, fixture value, subprocess argument, decorator, assertion, and executable statement.

For every changed file, parse immutable before/final blobs with `type_comments=True`; remove only leading docstrings from modules, classes, functions, and async functions; normalize `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining ASTs to match. A separate allowlist restricts comment edits to anchored blocks and adjacent blank lines. Compare directives and shebangs byte-for-byte.

## Scope
- `test_cli_help_writing_guidelines_jerboa.py` module docstring — retain its named positive/negative wording contract and deliberately non-global boundary.
- `test_completion_budget.py` module, three named test docstrings, assertion-adjacent explanations in `test_verify_step_floor_clamps_between_min_and_960`, and the `_seed` explanation in `test_explicit_operator_lower_budget_is_raised_to_floor` — retain the formula, bounds, default/explicit policy, and offline seam; do not alter assignments or assertions.
- `test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py` module and `_materialize_llm_error_tree` docstrings — retain vocabulary closure, exhaustive type mapping, and import-order caveat.
- `test_llm_config_authoritative_binding.py` module docstring — retain compose-once, bound/frozen configuration, fail-fast behavior, and secret exclusion.
- `test_llmrunner_error_codes_f75f_heldout.py` module docstring — retain type-discriminated error codes and the observable gate envelope.
- `test_operation_snapshot_authoritative_binding.py` module and the docstrings for tracker-root freezing, async MCP proxy binding, and bridge-setup recovery — retain authoritative reuse, whole-path freezing, async binding, overrides, live push-mode carve-out, and fail-open bridge setup.
- `test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py` module, `_reconciler_main`, and `_composed_by` docstrings plus the four anchored blocks in `test_surfaces_compose_equivalent_snapshot` — retain real entry-point coverage, absolute anchoring, and per-surface composition.
- `test_review_budget.py` module and the block between its two tests — retain the current workflow floor and operator-budget precedence.
- `test_review_ops_characterization.py` module docstring — retain public result shape and exact companion coverage locations.
- `test_workflow_error_codes_35ab.py` module docstring — retain unknown-step classification and observable classifier/dispatch checks.

Consumers are pytest, CLI help/content contracts, FastMCP, the reconciler entry point, documentation/evaluation fixtures, and `check_comment_hygiene.py`. No runtime docstring reader was found.

Preserve exactly: `test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py` BLE001/no-untyped-call directives; `test_llm_config_authoritative_binding.py` B017/override directives; and `test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py` attr-defined/no-untyped-def directives.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only scoped comments, true leading docstrings, or adjacent blank lines change; normalized AST equality passes.
- [ ] Runtime values, assertions, decorators, and executable statements remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every directive remains byte-identical and attached to the same statement.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and removes repetition, history, ornament, or obvious narration.
- [ ] A non-author reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per edited block with immutable before/final citations, preserved contract/consumer, before/after words, and both verdicts.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `semantic-preservation=PASS` and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing or failing rows block closure.
- [ ] The normalized guard, focused tests, comment-hygiene check, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass.

## Verification
Run the recorded normalized-AST/allowlist/directive comparator; the impacted contract test files; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; path-scoped `git diff --check`; and `make verify`. The independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality.
